cases.contract: Apply a one-unit credit to invoices whose subtotal is at least 100. Smaller invoices keep their subtotal.
cases.expected_behavior: An invoice with one 100-unit line costs 99. One 99-unit line costs 99.

defects.description: the credit is missing at the inclusive threshold
defects.consequence: A subtotal of exactly 100 is charged at 100 rather than 99.

cases.review_rubric: Require the relevant condition in rounding.py and its observable consequence. A subtotal of exactly 100 is charged at 100 rather than 99.
